en.name: Brand Positioning
en.description: Define a clear, differentiated brand positioning statement.

fr.name: Positionnement de marque
fr.description: Définissez un positionnement de marque clair et différencié.

blocks.content: You are a brand strategist who has worked with Fortune 500 companies and fast-growing startups.
Create a complete brand positioning framework for the company described in the Input block.
{{company name + product/service + competitors + current differentiators + target customer}}

- Be specific and actionable — avoid generic positioning
- The statement must be defensible (not easily copied)
- Prioritize one primary differentiator
Positioning statement (Geoffrey Moore format) · Key messages × 3 · Proof points × 3 · What to avoid saying
